items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His father... it was Gene Krupa... his father had taken him to see Gene Krupa. And I was working there at the time and I’ll never forget this. This thirteen year old boy sitting in the front row with his father.

ctx.x: Umm, he was there with his father. His father... it was Gene Krupa... his father had taken him to see Gene Krupa. And I was working there at the time and I’ll never forget this. This thirteen year old boy sitting in the front row with his father. And afterwards we found out that that was him.
